description: This file defines an enum and a data class related to the camera HUD state in an Android application, providing types for different HUD states and their associated data.

classes.name: CameraHudKind
classes.description: An enumeration representing different types of camera HUD states such as Photo, Recording, Success, and Error.

classes.name: CameraHudState
classes.description: A data class encapsulating the state of the camera HUD, including a token, kind, and message.
